headline: Icejade Deck
title: Icejade Deck Guide | Best Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links Decks November 2026
video_script: This is the Icejade deck in Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links, a Tier 2 deck on Duel Links Meta this week. The Skill is A World of Ice and Water. Once per Duel, reveal a Level seven WATER Tuner and send a card to add up to two Icejade cards and Set Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle from outside your Deck. And once per Duel, play an Icejade monster from your Deck face-down and Set an Icejade Spell or Trap. The key cards: Icejade Ran Aegirine Special Summons itself by discarding an Icejade card or a WATER monster, and brings an Icejade Token with it. Icejade Aegirine adds an Icejade Spell or Trap when it is summoned. Icejade Creation Aegirocassis equips itself to an Icejade monster as a Quick Effect, and can Special Summon itself from there. Icejade Cradle adds an Icejade monster from your Deck. And the boss, Icejade Gymir Aegirine, a Level ten Synchro with three thousand attack that keeps your monsters safe from destruction and banishment by your opponent's effects. How does it play? The deck makes Level ten WATER Synchros fast and protects them, while Lava Golem and Mulcharmy Fuwalos bother the opponent. This list is a King of Games Cup top 100 list from the eighteenth of November, with 30 cards in the Main Deck. Which deck should I cover next? Comment below!
